text_block_list.text: "She told me, ‘Feel free to use whichever of Maya's cosmetics you like~♪’, but――"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Which one works best for stinging burns...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Waaaahaaa~n! All this makeup
looks totally the same to me~!
